title: Expiring-soon view (<=7 days, nav count)
description: Expiring-soon view for items expiring within 7 days or already expired, soonest first, with a nav count
spec:
1. Open the expiring-soon view or filter chip.
2. Confirm it lists items whose expiry date is within 7 days OR already past.
3. Confirm items with no expiry date and items expiring more than 7 days out are excluded.
4. Confirm results are ordered soonest-expiry first (expired items ahead of soon-to-expire).
5. Confirm expired items are visually distinct from expiring-soon items.
6. Confirm the navigation surfaces an expiring-soon count that matches the number of qualifying items.
7. Edit an item's expiry to be beyond 7 days; confirm it drops out of the view and the nav count decrements.
8. Confirm the view is server-rendered and uses htmx idioms consistent with the other views.
